item.title: Asymmetric Arsenals: Dual-Use AI Breaches and Silicon Evasion Strain Western Edge
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
From AI-powered breaches of US spy agencies to illicit $270M GPU flows in China, Western defense modernizers face dual threats of digital exploitation and structural friction. Alexander Sterling breaks down the strategic fallout.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Illicit financing networks totaling hundreds of millions continue bypassing semiconductor export limits, fueling Chinese AI server infrastructure. [SPLIT] ⚡ Automated data collection and bot-driven public records clearing overload civilian-military bureaucracies, creating systemic operational friction. item.title: Algorithmic DoS: How AI Data Harvesters Are Paralysing Open Government
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Venture-backed startups and automated LLM tools are flooding public records systems with tens of thousands of automated FOIA requests daily. Is America's open-government infrastructure facing a structural Denial-of-Service attack?
[SPLIT] ⚡ Commercial entities account for up to 96% of public records inquiries at key federal agencies, transforming open-government mandates into proprietary corporate intelligence pipelines. [SPLIT] ⚡ Local administrative nodes face severe operational gridlock, diverting critical public-sector labor away from core governance functions toward manual data processing.
